zones.what: Lifeboats mounted at Deck 6 obstruct views from Deck 1, Deck 2, and partially Deck 6 balconies and ocean view cabins.
zones.effect: Ocean view and balcony cabins on these decks see lifeboats instead of open water when looking straight out or down; the horizon remains visible above the boats.
zones.mattersTo: Matters greatly to guests who want unobstructed water views or photos; insignificant to those focused on having a balcony for air and light or to interior cabin guests.

zones.what: Main pool deck and buffet venue are located on Deck 11, four decks above Deck 7 aft.
zones.effect: Deck 7 aft cabins are well insulated from pool deck activity by distance; noise and foot traffic are minimal.
zones.mattersTo: Not a concern for most guests given the four-deck separation.

zones.what: Pool deck, buffet, and outdoor activity areas are located on Deck 11, directly above Deck 10.
zones.effect: Deck 10 cabins experience daytime foot traffic, pool furniture scraping, and music from directly overhead; can continue into evening hours.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for light sleepers or guests in cabins during the day; minor for those spending days off the ship or out and about.

zones.what: Engine room is located low and aft, directly below and adjacent to Deck 1 and Deck 2 aft cabins.
zones.effect: Low-frequency vibration and hum are noticeable underway, especially at night when ambient noise is low.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to vibration-sensitive guests and light sleepers; less important to those who sleep through white noise or spend little time in the cabin.

zones.what: Bow thrusters located low and forward operate during docking and undocking maneuvers.
zones.effect: Brief but loud thruster noise occurs early morning arrivals and during port departures, typically lasting several minutes.
zones.mattersTo: Matters to light sleepers who are in the cabin during port days; irrelevant to early risers or those already awake.

zones.what: Anchor chain runs through the bow and drops each port arrival, typically early morning.
zones.effect: Loud rumbling and vibration in forward cabins during anchor deployment, lasting a few minutes per port call.
zones.mattersTo: Significant for light sleepers in forward cabins on port-intensive itineraries; minor for those who wake early anyway or on sea days.
